name: Wahaj: The Firefly's Journey
storyline: Deep in a magical forest, night has fallen and the crystal gates have woken up. A small firefly sets out on a journey through the dark, carrying only its own fragile glow. Its light fades with every moment, so it must gather the drops of light scattered through the forest to keep shining, while dodging glowing crystals and the bats that hunt in the shadows. If it survives long enough, the night gives way to dawn and the whole sky rains light.
summary:
Wahaj: The Firefly's Journey is an endless one-tap flying game in which the player guides a small glowing firefly through a magical night forest full of crystal gates. Tap to flap and hold to glide, and collect light drops to keep your glow alive, because a light meter drains constantly and the run ends when it runs out or you crash.

Crystal gates come in three types (steady, swinging and breathing), and every 60 points the night turns to dawn and the sky rains light. Each run gets faster and harder. Four power-ups help along the way: Light Shield, Magnet, Slow Time and Golden Glow (×2 points). Gliding fills a shield ring that grants up to three shields, while bats steal 5 points from your score.
